nodes.label: In-Context Meta LoRA Generation (ICM-LoRA)
nodes.author: Yihua Shao, Minxi Yan, Yang Liu, Siyu Chen, Wenjie Chen, Xinwei Long, Ziyang Yan, Lei Li, Chenyu Zhang, Nicu Sebe, Hao Tang, Yan Wang, Hao Zhao, Mengzhu Wang, Jingcai Guo

nodes.label: ICM-LoRA Framework
nodes.rationale: Proposes a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) trained on all tasks simultaneously to generate task-specific LoRA weights conditioned on task vectors, eliminating the need to train separate LoRA adapters per task; reduces storage to 1% of original LoRA while matching or exceeding reconstruction quality.

nodes.label: Conditional Variational Autoencoder for LoRA Generation
nodes.rationale: CVAE encoder maps (LoRA parameter, task vector) pairs to latent z; decoder reconstructs LoRA parameters conditioned on z and task vector; trained with ELBO combining reconstruction and KL divergence terms. Uses 12-layer 1D CNN architecture. Task-conditioned generation allows multi-task LoRA parameter sharing.

nodes.label: Task Vector Extraction via LLM/LVLM Hidden States
nodes.rationale: Task vectors are derived by averaging the hidden states at the last token of the last layer of a fine-tuned LLM/LVLM over task-specific samples; chosen because last-layer last-token representations capture high-level semantic features and form discriminative clusters per task category.

nodes.label: In-Context Meta-Learning for Parameter Generation
nodes.rationale: Combines ICL with meta-learning so the CVAE generator can model cross-task correlations and parameter distributions without storing raw datasets; enables task mapping between task descriptions and LoRA weight distributions.

hyperedges.label: Multi-task LoRA generation via task vectors and CVAE
hyperedges.description: ICM-LoRA's three-stage pipeline: task vectors condition the CVAE, which is trained via in-context meta-learning to capture cross-task correlations; together they enable single-generator multi-task LoRA parameter synthesis.
